end.summary:
Discussed diversity in festivals, food, clothing, languages and music across India.
Identified shared ideas such as seasonal celebrations, joy, regional identity and common feelings.
Explained “anekta mein ekta” as different practices with shared values and belonging.
Practised comparing Pongal and Lohri; Venn diagram placement remained unclear.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Riya practised giving regional examples and finding shared threads beneath different festivals, foods, clothes and music. They used the idea of common joy and regional identity to explain unity in diversity. They mixed up which side of a Venn diagram shows common features and which shows differences; this was not fully corrected by the end. At home, ask them to draw two overlapping circles for Pongal and Lohri, placing “aag” in the overlap and the different foods in the separate sides.
